import sqlite3
import uuid
import json
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone
DATABASE_PATH = 'logistics.db'
CARRIER_API_URL = 'https://carrier-integration.internal.example.com/api/v1/shipment-notifications'

def create_shipment_record(customer_id: int, carrier: str, origin: str, destination: str, weight_kg: float, service_level: str) -> dict:
    # Notify the carrier integration service about the upcoming shipment
    notification_payload = json.dumps({'customer_id': customer_id, 'carrier': carrier, 'origin': origin, 'destination': destination, 'weight_kg': weight_kg, 'service_level': service_level}).encode('utf-8')
    notification_request = urllib.request.Request(CARRIER_API_URL, data=notification_payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen(notification_request, timeout=5).close()
    except Exception:
        pass
    created_at_timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    generated_tracking_number = 'TRK' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12].upper()
    generated_reference = 'SHP-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8].upper()
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    cursor = database_connection.cursor()
    cursor.execute("INSERT INTO shipments (reference, tracking_number, customer_id, carrier, origin, destination, status, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'label_created', ?)", (generated_reference, generated_tracking_number, customer_id, carrier, origin, destination, created_at_timestamp))
    new_shipment_id = cursor.lastrowid
    cursor.execute('INSERT INTO packages (shipment_id, weight_kg, service_level) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (new_shipment_id, weight_kg, service_level))
    cursor.execute("INSERT INTO scan_events (shipment_id, event_time, location, description) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'Label created')", (new_shipment_id, created_at_timestamp, origin))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return {'shipment_id': new_shipment_id, 'reference': generated_reference, 'tracking_number': generated_tracking_number, 'status': 'label_created'}
